messages:
maria_rm: FYI deploybot flagged canary group B; p95 latency +40% vs baseline at 21:12 UTC.

deploybot: [ALERT] canary:group-B p95 latency 480ms (+42%) vs baseline 340ms. Error rate 0.5%. Auto-rollback: OFF (policy: manual for dedicated pools). See /deploy status 1719994300

tom_sre: I see a small increase in tail, but error rate still low. Any config flip? KV cache hits dropped for these slices.

anas_eng: Rolling config? We just pushed kv-cache eviction tweak 3m ago to reduce memory on ded-pool-2.

maria_rm: That was part of this release. We expected small mem savings but didn't anticipate latency impact. Given SLAs for dedicated customers, we need to decide rollback or pin.

kevin_pm: Can we pin traffic off group-B and route to group-A for affected customers? Or do a targeted rollback for ded-pool-2 only.

lia_cs: We already got 2 DED customers pinging. They want quick clarity — ETA for rollback?

maria_rm: Manual rollback ETA ~8-12m if we run rollback playbook. Alternative: pin version to v2.5.6 for ded-pool-2 (non-disruptive) — needs ops signoff.

tom_sre: I can run the partial revert if Maria OK. Steps: 1) identify nodes in ded-pool-2, 2) /deploy rollback --pool ded-pool-2 --to v2.5.6, 3) monitor canary for 10m. I'll coordinate with oncall.

deploybot: Command suggestion: ```/deploy rollback --target ded-pool-2 --version v2.5.6 --reason "canary p95 spike" --no-auto-promote``` Use with approval.

anas_eng: Note: rolling back will reintroduce kv-cache eviction. We're good with that tradeoff for SLAs.

maria_rm: Approve. Tom, execute rollback now. Lia, prepare the status note for affected customers: include short reason, mitigation, and expected timeline.

tom_sre: Starting rollback. Posting logs to #incidents and updating runbook.

deploybot: [ACTION] rollback initiated by tom_sre for ded-pool-2 -> v2.5.6. Job 98321. Estimated 9m.

lia_cs: Drafting customer note, will paste for review shortly.

maria_rm: Quick reminder to freeze release notes publish until we confirm post-rollback metrics. Kevin, hold the public changelog slice.

kevin_pm: Done. Holding publish and updating release doc to note temporary rollback and follow-up investigation.

deploybot: Job 98321: progress 40% (nodes updated 6/15). p95 trending down to 360ms.

tom_sre: 80% complete. No new errors. Monitoring.

deploybot: Job 98321: complete. All nodes on v2.5.6. Canary p95 back to 345ms. Error rate stable.

maria_rm: Thanks team. Lia send the customer comms and update the release notes to mark rollback executed and root-cause investigation in progress.

lia_cs: Sent: "We rolled back a configuration change impacting latency for some dedicated customers; rollback complete, monitoring continues. Reach out for direct status." :mailbox_with_mail: 

maria_rm: Closing loop: we'll schedule a postmortem with eng/infra to discuss kv-cache behavior and safer canary gating. Assign action items afterwards.

anas_eng: I'll triage today and propose a safer toggle + metric to guard this.

tom_sre: Good run. No escalation needed. Keeping the incident thread in #incidents open for notes.
